en.name: Marshmallows
en.summary: An unopened bag of marshmallows keeps 1 year from purchase in a cool, dry cupboard, and about 1 month once opened. They are aerated sugar syrup set with gelatine, so nothing grows in them — they fail by drying hard or by absorbing humidity and fusing into a block.
en.pantry: 1 year from purchase, sealed, cool and dry; about 1 month after the bag is opened. The sugar in a marshmallow binds the water so tightly that there is essentially nothing available for microbes, which is why these are shelf-stable for a year without any preservative theatre. The real enemies are air and humidity: an open bag dries to a chewy, leathery lump in a dry room, and in a damp one the marshmallows go tacky and weld themselves together. Clip the bag hard or move them into an airtight box.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published, and the fridge is a poor choice. It is humid, so marshmallows come out sticky, and the cold firms them into something rubbery. The only moment it helps is when a bag has softened in a hot kitchen and you want them firm enough to separate. A sealed box in a cool cupboard is the better answer.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published either. Freezing does not spoil marshmallows and it is a common trick for keeping them from sticking, but there is no published figure and the cupboard already gives a year. If you do freeze them, use an airtight bag and let it come back to room temperature sealed, or condensation will glue them together.
en.thawing: Not normally required. Let a chilled or frozen bag warm up while still sealed before opening it.
spoilage: Marshmallows fused into one solid block after taking up moisture.
Hard, shrunken, leathery pieces that no longer squash.
A stale or off smell rather than a clean vanilla sweetness.
Any mould, which is rare and means the bag got genuinely wet.
tips: Reseal the bag with a clip the moment you open it, or decant into an airtight box.
Toss slightly sticky marshmallows with a little icing sugar or cornflour.
Dried-out marshmallows still melt perfectly well into hot chocolate or rice-crispy bars.
Keep the bag away from the kettle and the hob, where steam and heat do the damage.

faq.a: 1 year from purchase unopened in a cool, dry cupboard, and about 1 month once the bag is opened.

faq.q: Do marshmallows need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No. They are shelf-stable sugar confectionery and no refrigerated timeline is published. The fridge mostly makes them sticky and rubbery.

faq.q: My marshmallows have gone hard. Can I still use them?
faq.a: Yes. That is drying, not spoilage, and they melt just as well. Only mould or an off smell means throwing them out.

zh.name: 棉花糖
zh.summary: 未開封的棉花糖自購買日起，放在陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃可放 1 年，開封後大約 1 個月。它是打發的糖漿用明膠凝住的東西，裡面長不出什麼；它壞掉的方式是乾硬，或是吸濕之後黏成一整塊。
zh.pantry: 密封、陰涼、乾燥，自購買日起 1 年；開封後大約 1 個月。棉花糖裡的糖把水綁得很死，微生物幾乎沒有可用的水，所以它不必靠什麼花招就能常溫放一年。真正的敵人是空氣和濕氣：開封後放在乾燥的房間會乾成一塊有嚼勁的皮革，放在潮濕的房間則會發黏、互相黏死。請把袋口夾緊，或整包倒進氣密盒。
zh.fridge: 沒有冷藏的期限數據，而且冰箱不是好選擇。冰箱潮濕，棉花糖拿出來會黏手，低溫也讓它變得死韌。唯一有幫助的時機，是整包在熱廚房裡軟掉、你想讓它硬一點好分開。密封盒放陰涼櫥櫃是更好的答案。
zh.freezer: 冷凍同樣沒有期限數據。凍了不會壞，很多人也用這招避免沾黏，但沒有公開的數字，而櫥櫃本來就給了一年。真要凍，請用密封袋，並且維持密封回到室溫再打開，否則結露會把它們黏成一團。
zh.thawing: 一般不需要。冰過或凍過的整包，請維持密封回溫再開。
spoilage: 吸濕之後整包黏成一大塊。
變硬、縮水、像皮革一樣壓不下去。
聞起來是陳味或怪味，而不是乾淨的香草甜香。
任何發霉——很少見，出現就代表包裝真的進水了。
tips: 一開封就用夾子夾緊，或換到氣密盒。
有點黏的棉花糖，拌一點糖粉或玉米粉就好處理。
乾掉的棉花糖拿去泡熱可可或做米香棒一樣好用。
袋子遠離熱水壺和爐台，蒸氣和熱就是禍首。

faq.a: 未開封放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃，自購買日起 1 年；開封後大約 1 個月。
不需要。它是可常溫保存的糖果，而且沒有冷藏的期限數據。冰箱多半只會讓它黏手又變韌。

faq.q: 棉花糖變硬了還能用嗎？
faq.a: 可以，那是乾掉不是腐敗，拿去加熱融化一樣好用。只有發霉或有怪味才需要丟。
